metadata.color_semantics: teal #1F6F5C = the teleported state / good resource / restored qubit; crimson #BF3339 = blocked channel / destroyed original / scrambled form; never swap mid-film
metadata.note: Card exclusions honored: NO three-qubit amplitude bookkeeping (no |Ψ₀⟩ expansion), NO correction-table algebra (no full 4×4 table), NO dense-coding dual (that is candidate 09 / vox-dense-coding). One mechanism only: a pre-shared Bell pair plus two classical bits moves an unknown qubit state from Alice to Bob — no copy made, no FTL.
